Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B. Start at uus: the pair (uus, dxw) comes first; its second item is dxw, so the next pair is the one whose first item is dxw: (dxw, ddw). Its second item is ddw, but ddw never appears as a first item - so ddw is the dangling end of the chain.
ANSWER: uus, dxw, ddw
